rows.notes: The study is a narrative review of remote sensing (hyperspectral, visible-light/canopy colour, UAV, satellite) for plant nutrition diagnosis; it reports no data, experiment, survey or model runs of its own. All tables and figures (Table 1, 2, 3; Fig. 1-4) are reproduced from cited works [24, 25, 34, 49]. The review's own conclusions are only general statements that remote sensing is becoming widely used and must be combined with soil and plant testing; nothing on soil nutrient management is reported as an own result.
